data.name: Tulliana
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin 'Tullia', which means 'leaping' or 'shining'. In Roman mythology, Tullia was a goddess associated with fertility and the harvest. This name is often used in Christian contexts to honor the Virgin Mary, the mother of Jesus, who is also associated with fertility and the harvest.
